info.title: Hearing Loss: Myth vs. Fact
info.subtitle: The common beliefs that keep people from getting help

rows.title: Only affects the elderly
rows.desc: Noise-related loss happens at every age.

rows.title: It can wait
rows.desc: Early care eases effort and protects connection.

rows.title: Aids are big and obvious
rows.desc: Today's devices are small and discreet.

rows.title: My doctor would tell me
rows.desc: Routine visits rarely include a hearing test.

rows.title: Aids restore perfect hearing
rows.desc: They improve clarity, not flawless hearing.
